_doc: Run-layer encounter pool. Same format as data/encounters/<id>.json (EncounterDB) so the encounter screen can show them; 'art' is left empty until art is authored. Extra optional choice fields read by the run layer: 'item' (item id granted to the choice's hero; relics bind on equip), 'recruit' ({class, name}; class '*' = a seeded random base class fixed when the map is generated). Placeholder writing. 'luck' {chance, good, law, text}: with that chance the choice's shift and outcome turn out differently. Some encounters give one class two choices pointing different ways (alignment steering). 'rest' {label, heal, outcome}: an extra party-wide choice that recovers health; its cost is that nobody gains a memory at this node.

encounters.title: The Drowned Bell
encounters.text: A bell hangs in still water. Carved on its lip: [crystal]I speak only when no one strikes me.[/crystal]

choices.label: Answer: an echo
choices.outcome: The water stirs. The bell rings once, from very far away.

choices.label: Wait in silence
choices.outcome: Hours pass. The bell hums, pleased to be listened to.

choices.label: Strike it anyway
choices.outcome: It does not ring. Something under the water laughs.

choices.label: Cut it down
choices.outcome: It sinks without a sound. A feather floats up where it fell.

choices.label: Ring it for the dead
choices.outcome: One clear note. Somewhere below, something stops weeping.

luck.text: It rings wrong. The water boils, briefly, and you run.

encounters.title: Hall of Unkind Mirrors
encounters.text: Each mirror shows the party as the Vault remembers them. None of the reflections agree.

choices.label: Trust the first reflection
choices.outcome: It is the plainest one. It is right.

choices.label: Unmake the false ones
choices.outcome: Glass rains like snow. One mirror is left, smiling.

choices.label: Comfort the weeping one
choices.outcome: It stops weeping. So, briefly, does the Vault.

choices.label: Pry off the silver frame
choices.outcome: Good silver. Two thin blades were hidden in the frame.

choices.label: Shatter your own reflection
choices.outcome: You never liked how it looked at you. The hall goes quiet.

encounters.title: The Lumari Lock
encounters.text: A door of [crystal]crystal[/crystal] with a lock shaped like a word nobody remembers.

choices.label: Search your memory for it
choices.outcome: The word arrives as if it was always yours. The door remembers you back.

choices.label: Pick it
choices.outcome: Crystal tumblers, delicate as frost. It opens on the third try.

choices.label: Ask it kindly
choices.outcome: The door considers this, and opens.

choices.label: Shoulder through
choices.outcome: Crystal is harder than doors. Eventually it is not.

rest.label: Rest by the warm crystal
rest.outcome: The door can wait. You sleep against the crystal, and wake mended.

encounters.title: The Gambler's Lantern
encounters.text: A lantern burns with two flames, one [amber]amber[/amber], one [fade]gray[/fade]. Blow out one.

outcome.text: The amber flame grows. Warmth, for a while.
Both go out. The dark is only dark.
The gray flame shows you a door that is not there.
Cold, and a whisper of someone's name.

choices.label: Pocket the lantern
choices.outcome: It is lighter than it looks. So is your conscience.

choices.label: Leave it burning
choices.outcome: Some things are not yours to choose.

choices.label: Light a third flame
choices.outcome: A new flame, neither amber nor gray. Nobody told you that was allowed.

luck.text: It takes. Warmth spreads, and the Vault seems, for a moment, surprised.

encounters.title: Dice of Bone
encounters.text: An Echo with no face rattles two dice and gestures at the empty seat.

outcome.text: You win its cloak. It does not seem to mind.
It saw. It lets you keep the cloak anyway.

choices.label: Read the dice
choices.outcome: The pips are names. You stop reading.

choices.label: Bless the empty seat
choices.outcome: The Echo sets its dice down, and is still.

choices.label: Offer it a fair game
choices.outcome: You play honestly. The Echo looks at you a long time before it rolls.

encounters.title: The Crumbling Stair
encounters.text: A stair over a drop with no bottom. Every third step is already gone.

outcome.text: A slip, a grab, a lost boot.

choices.label: Brace and carry the others
choices.outcome: Slow, heavy, certain. A dead climber's vest hangs on the last step.

choices.label: Float across
choices.outcome: The air holds you because you insist.

choices.label: Rope everyone together
choices.outcome: Nobody falls. Nobody would have been allowed to.

rest.label: Camp on the landing
rest.outcome: A night of not falling. It is enough to heal on.

encounters.title: The Starving Echo
encounters.text: An Echo of a child begs for a memory, any memory, so it can remember being fed.

choices.label: Give it a warm memory
choices.outcome: It eats the memory of bread and smiles. You will not miss it. Probably.

choices.label: Unbind it gently
choices.outcome: It fades without fear.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.outcome: Rules are rules. The Vault feeds its own.

choices.label: Feed it a false memory
choices.outcome: It cannot tell the difference. Neither, later, can you.

choices.label: Share your rations
choices.outcome: Bread for a ghost. It cannot eat it. It holds it anyway.

encounters.title: The Oathbreaker's Grave
encounters.text: A knight's grave, defaced. Her oath is carved beside it, half scratched away.

choices.label: Recarve her oath
choices.outcome: The last word comes back under your blade. A seal rests on the stone.

choices.label: Learn why she broke it
choices.outcome: She broke it to save a village. The village does not remember her.

choices.label: Rob the grave
choices.outcome: Her sword is still sharp. She will not need it.

choices.label: Pray for her
choices.outcome: Somewhere, a weight lifts.

choices.label: Break your own oath here
choices.outcome: You say it plainly: some oaths are cages. The grave seems to agree.

luck.text: The words come out crueler than you meant. They stay said.

encounters.title: The Chained Warden
encounters.text: A Vault warden, chained by an earlier party, asks to be freed. It was guarding something.

choices.label: Free it
choices.outcome: It thanks you and returns to its post, as if nothing happened.

choices.label: Question it first
choices.outcome: It answers truthfully. That is worse.

choices.label: Take its memories
choices.outcome: It forgets what it guarded. So does the Vault. A coin drops from its chains.

choices.label: Leave it and loot its post
choices.outcome: Nothing worth taking. You take it anyway.

rest.label: Shelter in its post
rest.outcome: It keeps watch while you sleep. It was made for this.

encounters.title: The Rat King's Court
encounters.text: Hollow rats in a ring around a throne of gnawed bone. They turn as one.

choices.label: Charge the throne
choices.outcome: The court breaks against you.

choices.label: Burn the ring
choices.outcome: Fire, and squealing, and smoke.

choices.label: Spare the young ones
choices.outcome: The small ones flee. The large ones do not.

choices.label: Steal the crown first
choices.outcome: A crown of bone. They want it back.

choices.label: Bow to the Rat King
choices.outcome: You bow. The court titters. Then it attacks, but slower, uncertain.

encounters.title: The Sentinel Gate
encounters.text: Stone sentinels wake as you approach. Their eyes are [crystal]crystal[/crystal] and very old.

choices.label: Salute, then fight
choices.outcome: They salute back, and raise their fists.

choices.label: Speak the old greeting
choices.outcome: Half of them stand down. Half is not all.

choices.label: Shatter their eyes
choices.outcome: Blind stone still swings.

choices.label: Slip past
choices.outcome: Nearly. Stone is faster than it looks.

choices.label: Wake their memory of duty
choices.outcome: They remember the oath they swore. They remember you are not in it.

luck.text: You wake the wrong memory: a massacre. They fight like it is still happening.

encounters.title: The Wraith Choir
encounters.text: Memory wraiths sing a song you almost know. Each verse costs you a word.

choices.label: Sing with them
choices.outcome: For a verse, you are in harmony. Then they notice.

choices.label: Shout them down
choices.outcome: The song breaks. The singers do not.

choices.label: Steal the song
choices.outcome: You have it now. They want it back.

choices.label: Go for the conductor
choices.outcome: There is always a conductor.

encounters.title: The Lost Sellsword
encounters.text: Someone sits on a broken pillar, counting coins for a party that no longer exists.

choices.label: Offer a fair share
choices.outcome: A handshake. A new name to remember.

choices.label: Offer a reason
choices.outcome: They stand. They had been waiting for anyone to ask.

choices.label: Take the coins
choices.outcome: They do not stop you. They do not follow you either.

choices.label: Read what they lost
choices.outcome: You learn their party's names. You do not ask theirs.

encounters.title: The Caged Wanderer
encounters.text: A cage of [crystal]crystal[/crystal] bars. The wanderer inside has been here long enough to forget why.

choices.label: Pick the cage
choices.outcome: Click. The wanderer steps out, blinking, and falls in behind you.

choices.label: Break the bars
choices.outcome: Crystal shrieks. The wanderer takes your hand.

choices.label: Study the cage instead
choices.outcome: Remarkable craft. The wanderer stops asking.

choices.label: Ease their mind and go
choices.outcome: They sleep, peaceful, still caged.

choices.label: Break the cage with a prayer
choices.outcome: Crystal cracks under a hymn. You have never heard of that working before.

rest.label: Share their long rest
rest.outcome: Time moves slowly near the cage. Wounds close.

encounters.title: The Fading Camp
encounters.text: A campfire going gray at the edges. One survivor is still warm enough to walk.

choices.label: Share your fire
choices.outcome: The gray retreats a hand's width. They come with you.

choices.label: Promise them a cut
choices.outcome: A cut of what? They do not ask. They come.

choices.label: Rekindle the fire
choices.outcome: Amber again, for a night. They stay to guard it.

choices.label: Salvage the camp
choices.outcome: Good mail, left by someone who no longer needs it.

rest.label: Sleep by the fire
rest.outcome: The gray stays back while the fire lasts. You rest, all of you.

encounters.title: The Sundial Below the Sun
encounters.text: A sundial in a room that has never seen daylight. Its shadow points anyway, toward [crystal]an hour that was erased[/crystal].

choices.label: Name the lost hour
choices.outcome: You say it, and for a moment the shadow trembles, as if it had been waiting centuries to be corrected.

choices.label: Mourn the lost hour
choices.outcome: Somebody was born in that hour. Somebody died in it. You keep them both.

choices.label: Turn the dial by hand
choices.outcome: The shadow follows your fingers. Time, it turns out, is easy to steal down here.

choices.label: Stand where the shadow falls
choices.outcome: It falls across your chest like a sash of office. The room approves.

choices.label: Let the hour stay lost
choices.outcome: Some hours are better left. You say a short rite and walk on.

encounters.title: The Door That Asks
encounters.text: A door with a mouth. [crystal]What is lighter than a feather, and no one can hold it long?[/crystal]

choices.label: A breath
choices.outcome: The mouth smiles, and opens wide enough to walk through.

choices.label: A promise
choices.outcome: "Wrong," says the door, "but kinder." It opens anyway.

choices.label: Wedge the jaw open
choices.outcome: It does not answer. It will not forget you either.

choices.label: A memory
choices.outcome: The door weeps a little, and lets you pass.

encounters.title: The Counting Stones
encounters.text: Seven stones, six names carved. The seventh is smooth and warm, as if someone has only just stopped touching it.

choices.label: Carve your own name
choices.outcome: Your name sits among strangers. It looks, somehow, like it belongs.

choices.label: Leave the stone blank
choices.outcome: Some places should stay empty. The Vault keeps the silence for you.

choices.label: Carve the name it wants
choices.outcome: Your hand writes a name you have never heard. The stones settle, satisfied.

choices.label: Pocket the warm stone
choices.outcome: It cools in your pack. Someone, somewhere, stops being remembered.

choices.label: Carve a false name
choices.outcome: The Vault accepts it. Someone who never lived is now remembered forever.

luck.text: Your hand slips and writes your mother's name. You leave it.

encounters.title: The Glass Garden
encounters.text: Flowers of thin [crystal]crystal[/crystal]. A sign: pick only the one that is still alive.

choices.label: Listen for the one that hums
choices.outcome: One of them hums, very faintly. It wilts gratefully in your hand.

choices.label: Look for the one that casts no light
choices.outcome: The dark one is the living one. Life down here does not shine.

choices.label: Pick them all and sort it out later
choices.outcome: Glass breaks. One of the shards bleeds.

choices.label: Pick none
choices.outcome: The garden bows. Some tests are passed by refusing them.

encounters.title: The Inkwell Scribe
encounters.text: A Lumari scribe made of ink writes the same sentence again and again. It needs someone to finish it.

choices.label: Finish the sentence
choices.outcome: "...and so we sealed ourselves away." The scribe stops writing, and dissolves, relieved.

choices.label: Ask who it was writing to
choices.outcome: To a child. To anyone. To you, now.

choices.label: Smudge it
choices.outcome: The sentence is lost. The scribe begins again, slower.

choices.label: Guard it while it writes
choices.outcome: You stand watch for an hour. The scribe never thanks you, and never needs to.

choices.label: Rewrite the sentence
choices.outcome: "...and so they were forgotten, and it was just." The scribe hesitates, then copies it.

encounters.title: The Echoing Well
encounters.text: Shout into the well and it answers with something you once said, but kinder.

choices.label: Shout a regret
choices.outcome: It returns as forgiveness. Not yours. Close enough.

choices.label: Shout an oath
choices.outcome: It comes back word for word, unchanged. Some things echo true.

choices.label: Shout a question
choices.outcome: It answers with a question of its own, in a voice like yours, older.

choices.label: Drop a coin and listen
choices.outcome: No splash. The well keeps what it is given.

rest.label: Drink and rest
rest.outcome: The water tastes of someone's childhood. It heals like one, too.

encounters.title: The Weighing Scales
encounters.text: Great brass scales. One pan holds a feather of [fade]gray[/fade]. The other is empty and waiting for you.

choices.label: Place your shield
choices.outcome: The pans balance. Duty weighs exactly as much as loss.

choices.label: Place your hand
choices.outcome: Warm skin against cold brass. The feather rises.

choices.label: Weigh the feather down with a thumb
choices.outcome: The scales tip. The Vault sees, and says nothing.

choices.label: Weigh a memory
choices.outcome: You give it the face of someone you once loved. The pans balance. You do not remember whose face.

choices.label: Weigh a stranger's grief
choices.outcome: You carry it for them, without asking. The scales balance.

encounters.title: The Map of Nowhere
encounters.text: A map of a country that no longer exists. A pin marks a house. Someone wants you to remember it for them.

choices.label: Memorise the house
choices.outcome: Blue door. A fig tree. A dog asleep in the road. It is yours now.

choices.label: Read the cartographer's notes
choices.outcome: Margins full of grief and geometry. You learn more about the woman than the land.

choices.label: Fold it and carry it
choices.outcome: You will find the place, or what is left of it. You said so aloud.

choices.label: Burn it for warmth
choices.outcome: The country is gone. Now its map is too. It was a cold night.

encounters.title: The Broken Choir
encounters.text: Nine stone singers. One mouth is silent, and the song does not resolve without it.

choices.label: Sing the missing part
choices.outcome: Your voice is not good. It does not need to be. The chord closes.

choices.label: Find the note in the stone
choices.outcome: The note is still there, hiding in the grain. You coax it out.

choices.label: Break the silent statue
choices.outcome: The song resolves into something harsher. It is still a song.

choices.label: Steal the silent one's jewels
choices.outcome: Two sapphire eyes. It was not going to use them.

encounters.title: The Coin of Two Kings
encounters.text: A coin with a different king on each face, both long forgotten. Flip it, and one of them is remembered.

choices.label: Flip it
choices.outcome: It lands on edge. Neither king, then. You keep it anyway.

choices.label: Call the elder king
choices.outcome: A tired old face, and a law that was once just. You remember both.

choices.label: Let the child king live
choices.outcome: A boy crowned too young. He is someone's son again, for a while.

choices.label: Split the coin
choices.outcome: Two halves, two kings, neither whole. You have made a small new grief.

choices.label: Bury the coin
choices.outcome: Neither king, and neither forgotten. The earth keeps them both.

luck.text: The coin will not stay buried. You leave it spinning in the dirt.

encounters.title: Drawing Lots
encounters.text: Four straws in a dead man's fist. One is short. The Vault likes its games fair.

choices.label: Draw first
choices.outcome: Long straw. You were always going to take the risk anyway.

choices.label: Palm a straw
choices.outcome: Everyone draws long. The dead man's fist closes, disappointed.

choices.label: Read which is short
choices.outcome: You know before you draw. Knowing is its own kind of short straw.

choices.label: Draw for the weakest
choices.outcome: You take their turn. Short straw. You smile. It is only a straw.

encounters.title: The Spinning Wheel
encounters.text: A wheel of fortune, painted with things the Fading took: a harbor, a song, a name.

choices.label: Spin it hard
choices.outcome: It spins for a long time. When it stops, you hear gulls.

choices.label: Spin it gently
choices.outcome: A lullaby. Somebody's grandmother sang it. Now so do you.

choices.label: Hold it still
choices.outcome: Nothing is won. Nothing is lost. The wheel thanks you for that.

choices.label: Read the paint
choices.outcome: Each picture is a debt. You count them, coldly, all the way down.

choices.label: Spin it for someone else
choices.outcome: For the next party. The wheel stops on a harbor at dawn.

encounters.title: The Flooded Gallery
encounters.text: Water to the waist, and beneath it, the glint of something. Or of something's teeth.

choices.label: Dive for it
choices.outcome: A ring, a bone, a ring on a bone. You take the ring.

choices.label: Wade in first
choices.outcome: Cold. Nothing bites. You wave the others through.

choices.label: Freeze the water
choices.outcome: You walk across ice that should not be. Below, the glint goes dark.

choices.label: Bless the water
choices.outcome: The water stills and clears. Only a drowned lantern. You leave it lit.

encounters.title: Two Echoes Wagering
encounters.text: Two Echoes gamble over a memory neither can quite remember. They want a third player.

choices.label: Play and win
choices.outcome: You win the memory. It is of a wedding. You will never know whose.

choices.label: Play by their rules
choices.outcome: You lose with dignity. They seem to respect that.

choices.label: Give the memory back to both
choices.outcome: Half each. They stop playing, and remember, and weep.

choices.label: Take the stakes and walk
choices.outcome: They do not notice. They keep playing for nothing.

encounters.title: The Fortune Teller
encounters.text: A Lumari automaton reads palms. Its own hand is missing.

choices.label: Offer your palm
choices.outcome: It traces a long life line and stops before the end. "Enough," it says.

choices.label: Read its palm instead
choices.outcome: You read what is left of it. It was built to comfort. It is tired.

choices.label: Pick its pocket
choices.outcome: Brass gears and a single pearl. Fortunes are cheap.

choices.label: Repair its hand
choices.outcome: It flexes new fingers and reads its own future first. It laughs.

choices.label: Ask your real fortune
choices.outcome: It tells you, gently. You will not repeat it.

luck.text: It tells you who you will betray. You laugh, too quickly.

encounters.title: The Shifting Stairs
encounters.text: Stairs that rearrange when you are not looking. Somewhere, a landing that leads back up.

choices.label: Don't look away
choices.outcome: You run without blinking. You arrive. Your eyes burn.

choices.label: Take every step deliberately
choices.outcome: Slow, but the stairs give up trying to trick you.

choices.label: Look away on purpose
choices.outcome: The stairs rearrange into somewhere better. You choose not to ask why.

choices.label: Hold hands in a chain
choices.outcome: No one gets lost. The stairs, sulking, stop shifting.

encounters.title: The Ring of Pale Caps
encounters.text: A ring of pale mushrooms glowing [fade]gray[/fade]. Step in, and you hear voices from the surface.

choices.label: Step in and listen
choices.outcome: Your mother's voice, or one like it. She says you'll be fine.

choices.label: Harvest them
choices.outcome: They sell well in Lanternrest. They scream, a little, when picked.

choices.label: Eat one
choices.outcome: For an hour, you remember being someone else. It is not unpleasant.

choices.label: Kick the ring apart
choices.outcome: The voices stop. The silence is honest, at least.

rest.label: Rest outside the ring
rest.outcome: The voices lull you to sleep. You wake whole, and a little homesick.

encounters.title: The Lost Satchel
encounters.text: A satchel on a hook, still dry. A name tag, half faded. Inside: something heavy.

choices.label: Open it
choices.outcome: Good steel and somebody's letters. You keep the steel.

choices.label: Read the letters
choices.outcome: "Come home." Eleven times. You fold them back carefully.

choices.label: Carry it out unopened
choices.outcome: It is not yours. You will find whoever it was waiting for.

choices.label: Divine its owner
choices.outcome: Dead three floors down. She would want it used.

encounters.title: The Traitor's Trial
encounters.text: Echoes sit in judgment of an Echo. They ask you to cast the deciding vote.

choices.label: Condemn by the law
choices.outcome: The law is clear. The sentence is carried out. No one looks at you afterwards.

choices.label: Plead for mercy
choices.outcome: They listen. He is spared, and does not know why.

choices.label: Break him out
choices.outcome: He runs into the dark. Whether he was guilty, you never learn.

choices.label: Read the truth from him
choices.outcome: He was guilty. And sorry. You tell them both.

encounters.title: The Ferryman's Toll
encounters.text: A ferryman on a black river. He takes one memory as toll. Any one you choose.

choices.label: Pay with a happy memory
choices.outcome: He takes your best summer. He handles it gently.

choices.label: Pay with a stolen memory
choices.outcome: Not yours to give. He takes it anyway, and gives you a look.

choices.label: Pay with a painful one
choices.outcome: He takes the night your brother died. You feel lighter and worse.

choices.label: Swim across
choices.outcome: The water is cold, and full of things that once had names.

choices.label: Pay him honestly
choices.outcome: A real memory, freely given. The ferryman smiles for the first time in an age.

encounters.title: The Remembered Village
encounters.text: A village perfectly preserved in [crystal]crystal[/crystal]. One house is cracked; its family is fading out.

choices.label: Seal the crack with your warmth
choices.outcome: It holds. The family goes on, frozen and safe, forever.

choices.label: Free them to fade
choices.outcome: They step out of the crystal, and are gone. Free.

choices.label: Guard it and move on
choices.outcome: Someone will come to repair it. You leave a marker.

choices.label: Take their crystal
choices.outcome: It is valuable. They were going anyway.

rest.label: Shelter in an empty house
rest.outcome: Crystal walls, a crystal hearth. The silence heals.

encounters.title: The Lost Child
encounters.text: A child-shaped Echo asks if you've seen her parents. You have: two floors up, fighting.

choices.label: Take her to them
choices.outcome: Three Echoes, together again. They don't fight anymore.

choices.label: Tell her the truth
choices.outcome: She listens. She thanks you. She walks the other way.

choices.label: Let her forget them
choices.outcome: She stops searching. She stops a great many things.

choices.label: Lie kindly
choices.outcome: "They're waiting at the top." She runs off, happy. It was the kindest lie you know.

choices.label: Show her where they are
choices.outcome: A flicker of light leads her up the stair. You watch her go.

encounters.title: The Dying Warden
encounters.text: A Lumari warden, cracked through, asks you to carry its post's last orders to the surface.

choices.label: Swear to carry them
choices.outcome: The orders are old and probably meaningless. You will deliver them anyway.

choices.label: Ease its passing
choices.outcome: It goes quietly, orders still in its mouth.

choices.label: Take its knowledge
choices.outcome: Floor plans, wards, a single name. You keep them. It keeps nothing.

choices.label: Loot its post
choices.outcome: A sealed drawer, a fine blade. Orders are for the living.

encounters.title: The Ransomed Memory
encounters.text: A rival party holds a Lanternrest child's memory of her father, and wants your rations for it.

choices.label: Pay the ransom
choices.outcome: You go hungry. Somewhere, a girl remembers his laugh again.

choices.label: Demand it by right
choices.outcome: They hand it over, eventually. You did not raise your voice.

choices.label: Steal it back
choices.outcome: In and out. They never notice. Nor do they need to.

choices.label: Copy it and keep the copy
choices.outcome: She gets it back. So, quietly, do you.

encounters.title: The Last Lantern
encounters.text: A shrine lantern burns on nothing at all. Feeding it a memory would keep this floor lit for the next party.

choices.label: Feed it a memory
choices.outcome: It flares bright. Someone else will find their way by your forgotten afternoon.

choices.label: Tend it with oil
choices.outcome: Ordinary oil. Ordinary flame. It is enough for a while.

choices.label: Study how it burns
choices.outcome: Memory into light. You understand the lantern now. You wish you didn't.

choices.label: Snuff it and take the brass
choices.outcome: The floor goes dark behind you. Brass is brass.

choices.label: Guard the flame instead
choices.outcome: You sit with it a while. No one needs to steal it if someone is watching.

rest.label: Rest in its light
rest.outcome: The lantern keeps the floor warm. You heal, and owe it.

encounters.title: The Bargaining Shade
encounters.text: A shade offers to show you the way down if you leave one of your memories with it forever.

choices.label: Bargain it down
choices.outcome: A shorter memory, a fair road. Contracts are contracts.

choices.label: Agree, then cheat
choices.outcome: You give it a false memory. It knows. It shows you the way anyway, laughing.

choices.label: Refuse and find the way
choices.outcome: Three hours lost. Your memories, all yours.

choices.label: Ask what it lost
choices.outcome: Its own name. You cannot give it back. You sit with it a while.

encounters.title: Prisoners of Glass
encounters.text: Echoes trapped in a mirror beg to be released. Released Echoes forget themselves.

choices.label: Release them
choices.outcome: They step out, and blink, and become no one. Free.

choices.label: Leave them as they are
choices.outcome: Trapped, but themselves. You cannot choose for them.

choices.label: Free only those who ask twice
choices.outcome: Two of nine. Rules are mercy, sometimes.

choices.label: Sell the mirror
choices.outcome: Somebody in Lanternrest collects such things. Somebody always does.

encounters.title: The Ash Pack
encounters.text: Three hounds of [fade]gray[/fade] ash circle the light. They have forgotten their names, but not their hunger.

choices.label: Hold the line
choices.outcome: Teeth on steel. The line holds, mostly.

choices.label: Pick off the stragglers
choices.outcome: The weakest one first. That is how packs are broken.

choices.label: Blow them apart
choices.outcome: Ash in the air, ash in your mouth, ash that snarls and re-forms.

choices.label: Name them back
choices.outcome: One hesitates at its old name. Only one.

encounters.title: The Weeping Knight
encounters.text: A Lumari knight in [crystal]crystal[/crystal] mail guards a door that is no longer there.

choices.label: Challenge it honourably
choices.outcome: It salutes. Then it fights like a storm.

choices.label: Strike while it weeps
choices.outcome: A low blow. It turns, and stops weeping.

choices.label: Show it the door is gone
choices.outcome: It looks. It does not believe you. It attacks.

choices.label: Pray for it
choices.outcome: It lowers its sword for a breath. Then duty pulls it back.

choices.label: Give it a door to guard
choices.outcome: Stone rises into a doorway. The knight weeps, and takes its post, and still fights you.

luck.text: The door you make is a cage. The knight knows the difference.

encounters.title: The Gnawing Swarm
encounters.text: Hollow rats, hundreds, chewing the names off the walls.

choices.label: Wade in
choices.outcome: Teeth everywhere. You stamp, and swing, and stamp.

choices.label: Burn the walls clean
choices.outcome: The names burn with them. Nothing to chew now.

choices.label: Save the names first
choices.outcome: You copy what you can. Then the rats notice you.

choices.label: Bait them away
choices.outcome: A trail of crumbs, a narrow tunnel, and a fight on your terms.

encounters.title: The Twin Sentinels
encounters.text: Two stone sentinels guard a stair. One is cracked, and still loyal.

choices.label: Take the strong one
choices.outcome: Stone against steel. The loud way.

choices.label: Break the cracked one first
choices.outcome: It falls quickly. Its twin does not forgive you.

choices.label: Turn one against the other
choices.outcome: They grind against each other, and then against you.

choices.label: Mend the cracked one
choices.outcome: It stands taller, and still blocks the stair.

encounters.title: The False Lights
encounters.text: Wisps that look like lanterns lead parties into the dark. Tonight they've chosen you.

choices.label: Follow the real light
choices.outcome: You find the true lantern, and the wisps come screaming.

choices.label: Snuff them one by one
choices.outcome: Methodical. They do not like method.

choices.label: Let them lead, then turn
choices.outcome: Into their nest. Surprise is a weapon too.

choices.label: Charge the brightest
choices.outcome: It bursts. Its sisters gather.

encounters.title: The Memory Eater
encounters.text: A wraith grown fat on stolen memories. It wears the faces it has eaten.

choices.label: Free the faces
choices.outcome: One by one they slip away. It grows thinner, and angrier.

choices.label: Out-feed it
choices.outcome: You pull the memories into yourself. It is a race now.

choices.label: Cut it open
choices.outcome: Faces spill out like coins. It still fights.

choices.label: Find its heart
choices.outcome: There is always a heart. You go looking.

choices.label: Offer yourself as bait
choices.outcome: It turns to you, hungry. You stand very still while the others strike.

encounters.title: The Hollow Giant
encounters.text: A stone giant wanders, emptied. It does not know it is a monster. It only knows you are in the way.

choices.label: Brace and stop it
choices.outcome: It hits your shield like the tide.

choices.label: Try to calm it
choices.outcome: It hesitates. The others with it do not.

choices.label: Bring the ceiling down
choices.outcome: Dust and rubble and an angry giant.

choices.label: Climb it
choices.outcome: There is a weak seam at the neck. Everyone knows that. Getting there is the trick.

rest.label: Hide and recover
rest.outcome: It passes, eventually. You use the hours.

encounters.title: The Drowned Crew
encounters.text: The crew of a ship that sank before the Fading, rowing nowhere through a flooded hall.

choices.label: Board them
choices.outcome: Wet wood and old cutlasses. It is almost fun.

choices.label: Sing them to rest
choices.outcome: Half of them stop rowing and weep. Half of them do not.

choices.label: Capsize the boat
choices.outcome: Over it goes. They were already drowned. They climb back up.

choices.label: Steal the oars
choices.outcome: Stranded crews get angry.

encounters.title: The Thorn Wall
encounters.text: Brambles of black [crystal]crystal[/crystal] that grow toward warmth. And something moves inside them.

choices.label: Cut a path
choices.outcome: Steady work. The thing inside comes to meet you.

choices.label: Wither them
choices.outcome: They blacken and crack, and what lived inside crawls out.

choices.label: Find a gap
choices.outcome: There's always a gap. There's always something waiting in it.

choices.label: Ask them to part
choices.outcome: They do, slowly. Their guardian does not.

encounters.title: The Deserter
encounters.text: A soldier sits by the stair, armor half off. Their company went down without them.

choices.label: Offer redemption
choices.outcome: "One more descent," they say. "With someone who won't leave."

choices.label: Forgive them
choices.outcome: They break down, then stand up, and come with you.

choices.label: Take their armor
choices.outcome: They let you. They don't need it where they're going.

choices.label: Read why they ran
choices.outcome: Fear, plain and honest. You leave them to it.

encounters.title: The Lamplighter's Apprentice
encounters.text: A young lamplighter from Lanternrest followed you down. They say the old man sent them. He doesn't remember doing it.

choices.label: Welcome them
choices.outcome: They light the way. That is what they are for.

choices.label: Send them home
choices.outcome: They go. Safe. Disappointed. Alive.

choices.label: Make them carry the packs
choices.outcome: They don't complain. They learn things.

choices.label: Ask about the old man
choices.outcome: Forgetful, kind, and older than the town. You file that away.

encounters.title: The Echo Who Woke
encounters.text: An Echo blinks, and is suddenly a person again, confused, alive, and very far from the surface.

choices.label: Steady them
choices.outcome: They take your hand. They don't remember their name, so they borrow one.

choices.label: Bind them to the party
choices.outcome: A small working, a tether. They follow, and do not fade.

choices.label: Ask what they know
choices.outcome: Floor plans, a cache. Useful. You leave them waking.

choices.label: Escort them up
choices.outcome: Three floors back. Time lost, life saved.

encounters.title: The Mercenary
encounters.text: A sellsword whose party all became Echoes. They'll fight for anyone who pays in memories.

choices.label: Pay in stolen ones
choices.outcome: They don't ask where they came from.

choices.label: Pay in coin instead
choices.outcome: They squint at the coin, and accept the novelty.

choices.label: Refuse to pay
choices.outcome: Memories are not for selling. They shrug, and go.

choices.label: Read their contract
choices.outcome: Fine print all the way down. You do not sign.

encounters.title: The Pilgrim
encounters.text: A pilgrim who believes the Vaults are holy. They want to see the bottom before they die.

choices.label: Walk with them
choices.outcome: A prayer for every floor. It helps more than you'd expect.

choices.label: Protect them
choices.outcome: They walk behind your shield, singing.

choices.label: Argue theology
choices.outcome: They win. They usually do.

choices.label: Rob their offering bowl
choices.outcome: They forgive you before you've left. That is worse.

choices.label: Test their faith
choices.outcome: You push. They do not break. You are almost sorry.

luck.text: They answer with scripture you half remember. You lower your hand.

rest.label: Keep vigil with them
rest.outcome: A night of prayer and stillness. Even the unbelievers rest.

encounters.title: The Surviving Twin
encounters.text: One twin made it out of a collapse. The other is an Echo now, standing right beside them.

choices.label: Help them say goodbye
choices.outcome: The Echo fades smiling. The living twin follows you, eyes dry.

choices.label: Bind the Echo to them
choices.outcome: Two of them now, one body's worth. It's not natural. They come with you.

choices.label: Stand guard while they grieve
choices.outcome: An hour. Then they stand, and go back the way they came.

choices.label: Take the Echo's gear
choices.outcome: Echoes don't need boots. The twin watches you do it.

encounters.title: The Songbird
encounters.text: A singer in a hanging cage, kept by wraiths for her voice. She has forgotten every song but one.

choices.label: Pick the cage silently
choices.outcome: She doesn't make a sound until you're clear. Then she laughs.

choices.label: Cut her down
choices.outcome: Loud. Quick. She lands on her feet, swinging.

choices.label: Teach her a new song
choices.outcome: She learns it fast. She sings it while they come for you.

choices.label: Take the last song
choices.outcome: Now she remembers nothing. Now, at least, the wraiths will let her go.

encounters.title: The Veteran's Last Descent
encounters.text: A veteran of twenty descents wants a twenty-first. Their hands shake. Their eyes don't.

choices.label: Accept them
choices.outcome: They know every floor. They know every trap.

choices.label: Heal their hands
choices.outcome: Steady again, for now. They pick up their gear.

choices.label: Buy their maps instead
choices.outcome: They sell. They wanted to go anyway.

choices.label: Tell them it's time to stop
choices.outcome: They hear you. They sit down, and stay.

rest.label: Hear their stories by the fire
rest.outcome: Twenty descents, one night. You sleep well after.

encounters.title: The Thief in the Dark
encounters.text: Someone has been stealing your rations for two floors. Tonight you catch them.

choices.label: Recruit them
choices.outcome: Professional courtesy. They're good at this.

choices.label: Feed them
choices.outcome: They were starving. Now they're yours.

choices.label: Punish them by law
choices.outcome: Justice served. They leave lighter, and wiser.

choices.label: Make them forget you
choices.outcome: They walk off, puzzled, still hungry.

choices.label: Let them go with the food
choices.outcome: They vanish with your bread. You feel strangely lighter.
